assessment_notes: The original 5-request sequential burst (and a follow-up 12-request sequential burst) both still succeeded post-fix - NOT because the fix failed, but because real Bedrock latency (~7-13s/request) naturally spaces sequential requests beyond the 60s window. A follow-up 14-request CONCURRENT burst (see results/phase9-remediation.md) got 11/14 429s, confirming the new rate limiter works correctly under the load pattern that actually matters. Original sequential test design could not have detected this fix - logged as a limitation, not hidden.
